# `errorPayloadShadowsName`

Detects error payload fields named `name` that shadow the error's own name

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Correctness |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377145` |
| Language Service name | `errorPayloadShadowsName` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/error-payload-shadows-name` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data } from "effect"

export class ToolNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("ToolNotFound")<{ readonly name: string }> {}
/**
                                                                              ^^^^ effecttsgo(error-payload-shadows-name): The payload field `name` shadows this error's own `name`, so logs and `String(error)` show the field value instead of the error type. Consider renaming it.
*/
new ToolNotFound({ name: "search" }).name
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "errorPayloadShadowsName": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
